# GolfDB / SwingNet — quarantined research code

Source: https://github.com/wmcnally/golfdb (McNally et al., CVPRW 2019).
Licence: **Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0**.

Used only to benchmark Swing Guru's own moment detector. Nothing under
`src/` imports this folder, and neither the code nor the weights
(`models/swingnet_1800.pth.tar`) may ship in a commercial product.
